author: anamonias
title: i was enjoying it until the time limit ruined it.
content:
today was a long day. i was outside all day at a festival and i was ready to relax on my ipad. i saw an ad for this game, so i downloaded it. 

i liked it at first, but then something happened when i was peacefully sorting items around—a beeping timer started yelling at me. 

i understand that the in game purchase of coins that can be used to continue the game after the time limit are most likely a key source of your income, but consider this:

—	adults and children alike use physical puzzles as a way to relax, where they are given unlimited amounts of time to enjoy it in real life
—	when i came across the ad for this game, there was no time limit, the time limit was not what me and likely many other players were expecting.

i also believe that this game has the potential to be much more aesthetically pleasing. your menu screen has a red blue color scheme (like that one game with the king that gets stuck under rocks or whatever if you know what i’m referring to) that doesn’t really match the cute little corner shop aesthetic while you actually play. 

a small peaceful shop with a stardew valley aesthetic with this concept of a pairing three items in the shop (with no time limit!) would do wonders for your game. think outside of the corporate mobile game box and make something memorable. i can’t feel anyone’s heart in this game. candy crush is up there because it has an aesthetic that really matches visually. 

anyways, it’s not up to me. i’m not sure if anyone will see this or change it but it’s worth a try😁

thanks for reading!

author: QVictoria1901
title: Fun Factor Ruined by Bad Rewards
content:
Goods Sorting has great, challenging gameplay and very clean graphics. It is genuinely fun to play, but the reward system completely ruins the experience. Standard levels only award 20 coins, and harder ones give 40–60, while a single booster costs over 300 coins. Because certain standard levels are practically impossible to beat without boosters, you are forced to watch endless ads or spend real money just to progress.
The decoration side quest is just as frustrating due to incredibly slow gem progression. Worse, once you max out the current decor level, you stop earning gems entirely. I actually reached out to support regarding this gem capping issue, but their response was highly disappointing and dismissive. Since direct player feedback was ignored, I am leaving this review in hopes that management takes player retention seriously. Please increase level rewards, fix the gem caps, and improve your customer care.

author: Abby2811
title: Favorite Game but has MAJOR flaws
content:
I never stick by games for long, just because I get bored, but this one I’ve had for a long time and I’m level 370.

The reason I rated it three stars is that, the ads are ridiculous. I don’t mean that there is a lot of them. It’s just that when they play, sometimes I get ads where I literally can’t skip them. Recently I got an ad that played 4 times before I could skip it, it was about a minute and a half long. That is just ridiculous.

Another reason is that the levels are almost unplayable now. I’m constantly running out of lives from failing the same level 5 times or more. I can’t make it through without watching ads to get more time, and then I only get 30 seconds which usually isn’t enough. The levels are purposely designed to where there literally is no way to make a match, resulting in running out of room. And again, you have to watch an ad just to play it. I loved this game when I first got it, the levels weren’t nearly as difficult. And yes I love challenges and appreciate the fact that they did get harder, but to an unplayable extent? It’s really annoying that I can’t get up to the three wins anymore for the extra 30 seconds because I’ll win a match finally, and then I’ll lose the next one five times. And then I’ll finally win that one and then lose the next one. 

It’s just getting to the point where it’s not fun anymore. I wish that were fixed.

Other than those two things, this game is my favorite. I play it every day. Just bugs me.
